audit.whatIsWrong: Two separate kit errors repeated across the whole page. (1) His W is called the 'Aegis stun' — Aegis Assault is his E; the W is Shield Vault. (2) The page says 'his passive blocks turret basic-shots' in five places. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will, which empowers his next spell; it blocks nothing.
audit.why: The blocking belongs to Aegis Assault (E, 22s at rank 1): he sets his shield and is invulnerable to damage from the front — and the kit flags it as a channel that any CC cancels. Attributing it to a permanent passive tells the reader his auto-block is always on, which turns a 22-second window they can punish into a permanent condition they cannot.
audit.corrected: Shield Vault named as the point-click dash-stun; Aegis Assault named as the 22s frontal channel, with the grenade stated as the answer that cancels it; Mortal Will left out of the block claims entirely.
